_comment: Dataset registry. PCAPs are referenced/downloaded, NEVER committed (license + size). Record the source URL, license/citation, and the ground-truth labels file per scenario. Add an entry, drop the PCAP where BENCH_PCAP points, and run: python benchmarks/run.py <name>.

synthetic-beacon.description: Bundled, license-clean smoke scenario: one C2 beacon host among benign traffic. Runnable with no external download (see --from-docs).

cic-ids-2017-friday.description: CIC-IDS2017 Friday (botnet + portscan + DDoS). Full PCAP + labels.
cic-ids-2017-friday.license: UNB CIC — free for research, citation required (Sharafaldin et al., ICISSP 2018)
cic-ids-2017-friday.note: Download the PCAP yourself; set BENCH_PCAP_DIR. Do not commit it.

ctu-13-neris.license: Stratosphere — PCAP privacy-limited; may be flow-only
ctu-13-neris.note: 2011 botnet — expect the dataset-age caveat: current ET Open rules may not fire (fairness note, not a failure).
